DepositPayment.title: Deposit Payment
DepositPayment.description: A deposit (partial or full prepayment) collected at booking time via Mollie or Stripe, routed through OpenConnector. On authorization a Shillinq AR invoice is materialised; on void an AR credit note reverses it. Payment routing, tokenization and gateway selection are OpenConnector's responsibility: this register never stores card data.

orderId.description: FK to the booking Order this deposit secures. Cross-app reference into the booking module; not resolved inside Shillinq.
orderId.title: Order ID

bookingTypeId.description: FK to the BookingType whose depositRule produced this deposit (cross-app reference for rule lookup).
bookingTypeId.title: Booking Type ID

amount.description: Deposit amount in minor units (EUR cents). 7500 = EUR 75.00.
amount.title: Amount

currencyCode.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Always EUR for now; a distinct field so T5 multi-currency does not break T2 logic.
currencyCode.title: Currency Code

taxRate.description: VAT rate (percent) applied when materialising the AR invoice. Defaults to the Dutch standard rate.
taxRate.title: Tax Rate

eventDate.description: Date of the booked event. Used together with dueOffsetDays to compute the deposit due date.
eventDate.title: Event Date

dueOffsetDays.description: Days before eventDate that the deposit is due, copied from the BookingType depositRule at creation. Range [0, 365].
dueOffsetDays.title: Due Offset Days

lineDescription.description: Human-readable description used for the AR invoice line item.
lineDescription.title: Line Description

state.description: Lifecycle state. draft: created, no payment intent yet; pending: payment intent created, awaiting gateway confirmation; authorized: funds reserved, AR invoice materialised; captured: funds settled; failed: authorization rejected; voided: refunded/cancelled, AR credit note created.
state.title: State

paymentIntentId.description: Opaque payment intent reference from the gateway (Mollie tr_XXXX or Stripe pi_XXXX). NOT a token; carries no card data.
paymentIntentId.title: Payment Intent ID

paymentGateway.description: Gateway selected by OpenConnector from customer preference.
paymentGateway.title: Payment Gateway

paymentMethod.description: Concrete payment method chosen at the gateway.
paymentMethod.title: Payment Method

arInvoiceId.description: FK to the Shillinq AR invoice materialised on authorization (one-to-one). Populated by the authorize-transition action.
arInvoiceId.title: AR Invoice ID

creditNoteId.description: FK to the Shillinq AR credit note materialised on void.
creditNoteId.title: Credit Note ID

refundPolicy.description: How a refund is handled on booking cancellation: automatic via OpenConnector, or queued for operator approval.
refundPolicy.title: Refund Policy

lastErrorCode.description: Machine error code from the last failed authorization (e.g. insufficient_funds).
lastErrorCode.title: Last Error Code

lastErrorMessage.description: Human-readable error message for the last failure, surfaced in the operator UI. Never contains card data.
lastErrorMessage.example: Insufficient funds. Please use a different card.
lastErrorMessage.title: Last Error Message

lastWebhookAttempt.description: Timestamp of the last gateway webhook event received for this deposit. Used by the polling fallback to detect stalled deposits.
lastWebhookAttempt.title: Last Webhook Attempt

authorizedAt.description: Timestamp when the payment was authorized.
authorizedAt.title: Authorized At

capturedAt.description: Timestamp when the payment was captured/settled.
capturedAt.title: Captured At

voidedAt.description: Timestamp when the deposit was voided/refunded.
voidedAt.title: Voided At

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Created. No payment intent yet; amount and rule are being validated.

pending.label: Pending
pending.description: Payment intent created at the gateway via OpenConnector; awaiting async confirmation (iDEAL/checkout).

authorized.label: Authorized
authorized.description: Funds reserved. An AR invoice has been materialised and the booking Order may advance to confirmed.

captured.label: Captured
captured.description: Funds settled into the merchant account.

failed.label: Failed
failed.description: Authorization rejected by the gateway. lastErrorCode/lastErrorMessage carry the reason.

voided.label: Voided
voided.description: Deposit refunded or cancelled. An AR credit note reverses the invoice.

requestPayment.label: Request payment
requestPayment.description: Create the payment intent at the gateway through OpenConnector and present the customer payment link. Validates the deposit rule preconditions before allowing the transition.

guard.description: Deposit rule must be valid: amount > 0, dueOffsetDays in [0,365], currencyCode is a 3-letter ISO code.

conditions.message: Deposit amount must be greater than zero.

action.description: Calls OpenConnector.createPaymentIntent(amount, currencyCode, orderId) and stores the returned paymentIntentId, paymentGateway and paymentMethod. No card data is stored.

authorize.label: Authorize
authorize.description: Idempotently mark the deposit authorized when the gateway confirms (webhook or polling fallback). Materialises the AR invoice.

action.description: Creates a Shillinq AR invoice for this deposit: customer derived from the Order, one line item (lineDescription, amount, taxRate), dueDate = eventDate minus dueOffsetDays, sourceDocumentUri = urn:nextcloud:booking:deposit-payment:@self.id. Stores the new invoice id in arInvoiceId.

fail.label: Fail
fail.description: Record an authorization failure. lastErrorCode/lastErrorMessage are set from the gateway response. The booking Order is cancelled by the booking module.

voidFromAuthorized.label: Void (refund)
voidFromAuthorized.description: Void an authorized deposit on booking cancellation. If refundPolicy = automatic_on_cancellation, initiate a refund via OpenConnector and create an AR credit note.

action.description: Initiates OpenConnector.initiateRefund(paymentIntentId, amount) when refundPolicy is automatic_on_cancellation, then creates a Shillinq AR credit note reversing arInvoiceId and stores it in creditNoteId.

voidFromCaptured.label: Void (refund captured)
voidFromCaptured.description: Void a captured deposit; same refund + credit-note behaviour as voidFromAuthorized.

action.description: Refund via OpenConnector and create the reversing AR credit note.

dueDate.description: The date the deposit invoice is due: eventDate minus dueOffsetDays. If the event is within dueOffsetDays from today, the deposit is due immediately.

vatAmount.description: VAT portion of the gross deposit amount, computed inclusive: amount - (amount / (1 + taxRate/100)).

netAmount.description: Net (ex-VAT) portion of the gross deposit amount.

paymentLink.description: Customer-facing payment URL embedded in the confirmation email. Embeds the deposit id, the AR invoice id and a short-lived signed token; clicking opens OpenConnector's hosted payment UI. Only meaningful while state is pending.

isOverdue.description: True when the deposit is still pending and its due date has passed.

byState.description: Number of deposits per lifecycle state: drives the Deposits overview state filter.

pendingByDueDate.description: Total pending deposit value grouped by due date, for the operator follow-up worklist.

failedCount.description: Count of failed deposits requiring operator follow-up.

onAuthorized.description: Confirm to the booking-operator that the deposit was authorized and the invoice was created.

subject.nl: Aanbetaling geautoriseerd: {{amount}} cent voor boeking {{orderId}}; factuur {{arInvoiceId}} aangemaakt
subject.en: Deposit authorized: {{amount}} cents for booking {{orderId}}; invoice {{arInvoiceId}} created

onFailed.description: Alert the booking-operator that a deposit authorization failed and needs follow-up.

onVoided.description: Confirm a refund was initiated and a credit note created.

subject.nl: Aanbetaling teruggeboekt voor boeking {{orderId}}; creditnota {{creditNoteId}} aangemaakt
subject.en: Deposit refunded for booking {{orderId}}; credit note {{creditNoteId}} created

shillinq-deposit-polling-fallback.name: Deposit polling fallback
shillinq-deposit-polling-fallback.description: Every 5 minutes, queries all DepositPayment records with state=pending and reconciles them against OpenConnector.getPaymentStatus(paymentIntentId), so a lost or delayed gateway webhook never leaves a deposit pending indefinitely. No app-local BackgroundJob extends TimedJob; reconciliation is idempotent.

depositStatus.title: Deposit
depositStatus.description: Booking-detail widget showing deposit state, amount, payment link and the linked AR invoice.

objects.lastErrorMessage: Insufficient funds. Please use a different card.
